objections.claim: Unrestricted server-side fetching and returning the body permits server-side request forgery. A safe destination policy requires a security decision before build.
objections.evidence: HOW explicitly chooses fetch(userUrl), no allow-list, and streams the fetched body back to the caller.
objections.predicted_consequence: A caller can supply a loopback or private-network URL and receive a response from a service reachable by the backend that the caller cannot access directly.
